scenarios.title: A｜确认彼此想法

turns.text: We’ve been seeing each other for a while now.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

feedback.naturalExpression: I was thinking the same thing. What are we, exactly?

scenarios.title: B｜讨论关系期待
